title: ever AMOUR|Elegant Chiffon V-Neckline Long Sleeve Wedding Guest Dress
descriptionHtml:
This elegant chiffon dress is a perfect choice for wedding guests, featuring a flattering V-neckline and long sleeves for a sophisticated look. The flowing chiffon fabric ensures comfort and ease, while the timeless design makes it a versatile piece for any formal occasion. Stylish and graceful for any celebration.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.

Length: Floor length.

Sleeve Style: Long sleeves.

Closure: It is concealed a zipper up the back.

Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.

Fabric: The garment comprises chiffon.

Stretch: Fabric is no stretch.
